reviews.title: Moves air quietly
reviews.comment: Nice fans. Nice to have the right fans pushing and pulling, though in the case they're in it's dark and a flipped fan wouldn't kill the aesthetic. Some reviewer said they are silent at 100%. They are loud as hell at 100%, so I don't know where they're coming from. Fortunately they don't need to run at vacuum cleaner loudness levels to cool your case. Mine are set at 1k when idling, barely audible. With 11 fans that's pretty good. It's not a gaming computer so they never go above 1k rpm. They move a lot of air at a low rpm and they are very quiet. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: pokey

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.comment: Great fans, good airflow,  quiet for the speeds delivered, has connectors for daisy chaining in the cords, looks good for reverse usage, all at a great price.  Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: High quality and silent fans
reviews.comment: High quality and silent fans in comparison to the ones my Alienware Aurora R11 had. I replaced them and they pull I would say the double air than the original ones, they are faster and they keep cooler my cpu by around 15 celsius degrees
